workarounds.symptom: [GHSA-hx9q-6w63-j58v] orjson does not limit recursion for deeply nested JSON documents (Affects orjson < 3.11.6)
workarounds.workaround: Upgrade orjson to patched release >= 3.11.6: pip install --upgrade 'orjson>=3.11.6' (Advisory: GHSA-hx9q-6w63-j58v)

workarounds.symptom: [PYSEC-2026-107] The orjson.dumps function in orjson thru 3.11.4 does not limit recursion for deeply nested JSON documents. (Affects orjson < 3.11.5)
workarounds.workaround: Upgrade orjson to patched release >= 3.11.5: pip install --upgrade 'orjson>=3.11.5' (Advisory: PYSEC-2026-107)
